body.name: Relevant-component forest/unicycle handle
body.construction: Given an explicit instance, first isolate the weak full-graph component containing \(X\) and \(Y\). Distinct components give a reachability cut. On a common component of cycle rank zero, \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\) dispatches to the value-path compiler. On a common component of cycle rank one, it cuts the unique factor-graph cycle at a boundary variable and carries the exceptional-edge reachability mode---shortcut retained, complementary arc already broken, or one specified repair edge---jointly with the local nonactual-value state; all other weak components are retained at their actual assignments.
